title: Building Production Terraform Infrastructure Modules
description: A comprehensive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) course on designing reusable Terraform modules, GCS/S3 remote state locking, input validation, and environment isolation.
body: Master modular cloud infrastructure management. Learn how to structure dry Terraform codebases, manage remote backend state locks in Google Cloud Storage, enforce input validation, and automate CI/CD plan checks.

sections.title: Section 1: DRY Modular Code Structure & State Management

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Structuring Reusable Terraform Modules
lessons.body: Organize IaC into modular `modules/` (reusable resource blocks) and `environments/` (`dev`, `test`, `prod`) to eliminate configuration drift.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.2: Remote State Locking with GCS / S3 Backends
lessons.body: Prevent concurrent state mutation race conditions using GCS remote backend state locking.
